practical_target.note: Engineering target (D-066, D-069): correct mode identity and acceptable MAC; frequency agreement preferably within ~5 %, up to ~10 % acceptable when the mode is correct and there is no branch mismatch. Separate from the formal M5 verdict; properties are never tuned merely to turn a useful 5 % mismatch into 1 %.

setup.source: SPEC §7 provisional Σ_setup 0.3 % (D-059, D-065); no measured same-panel remount estimate

measurement.source: the PolyMAX modal sources carry no modal uncertainty (M1 QC UNCERTAINTY_NOT_AVAILABLE; M5_DECISION_RECORD §6); never invented, never zero

not_fitted.t_face: NOT_FITTED: nominal FE geometry; the SPEC §5 prior needs 9+ thickness points per specimen, which are not recorded
not_fitted.k_core: NOT_FITTED: the existing INP core constants; no independent k_core prior (M6.3 NOT_AVAILABLE, D-059)
not_fitted.k_int: OFF: disabled by default (SPEC §5); the torsion holdout rule is kept
